title: Non-disclosure agreement; incident made classified
place_text: Ellsworth Air Force Base, South Dakota

tellings.quote: but then Jack Reed walked over and handed him this other piece of paper as he was putting mine down and it was uh an like a non-disclosure agreement

plain: Mario Woods, a former guard of nuclear weapons, told podcast host Jesse Michels about something that he says happened to him in 1977 at Ellsworth Air Force Base in South Dakota, an event he describes as a UFO abduction. Woods says that afterwards, while his own paperwork was being put down, a man named Jack Reed walked over and handed another person a non-disclosure agreement, a document that legally binds someone to keep quiet, and that the incident was made classified. He also names a Colonel Spraker. If true, it would mean the military worked to keep a UFO encounter at a nuclear base secret.
